items.text: Bears planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after full week of practice with no setbacks from hamstring; was listed questionable.
items.why: Full participant all week, starter reps, no setbacks post-torn hamstring.
items.implication: Return as QB1 option; boosts CHI pass catchers in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: Elevated snap/route volume for Bears skill players.

items.text: Eagles officially placed QB Jalen Hurts on IR due to blood clot after doctor consultations; out for the foreseeable future. Tanner McKee starts Sunday and beyond.
items.why: Superficial blood clot in calf; multi-doctor review led to IR decision Saturday.
items.implication: Long-term absence; McKee inherits starting role with healthy top pass-catchers but thin RB room.
items.opportunity: Stream McKee in 2QB/deep leagues; monitor PHI WR/TE target share stability.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown from IR to 53-man roster; expected to play Sunday vs Jets after high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Practiced this week; activated and cleared for return vs Jets.
items.implication: Immediate WR2 starter value if no setback; high usage expected in return.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets in NE offense; reverse any handcuff/backup WR stashes.

items.text: Pick up Tanner McKee in any league needing QB if available. He will be better than expected; not worried about any Eagles skill players with McKee under center.
items.why: McKee can play; skill talent remains intact despite thin RB.
items.implication: Stream McKee; hold/start PHI pass-catchers confidently.

items.text: Assuming AJ Brown active for Patriots, starting him as WR2 wherever rostered.
items.why: Activation and expected play after IR stint.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday Q add. Caleb/Metcalf/Olave/Dowdle more probable than Q. PIT thin WRs (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) so heavy 2-WR Metcalf + Bernard. PHI McKee has top-4 healthy (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) despite 4th-string RB.
items.why: Practice reports and designations; role/depth observations.
items.implication: Prioritize probable Qs; Metcalf usage spike in 2-WR; PHI pass-catchers stable with McKee.
items.opportunity: Metcalf target/route share increase; Warren monitor; Henderson risk.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Sunday (hamstring) alongside Jalen Hurts and Will Shipley.
items.why: Hamstring injury; ruled out on final report.
items.implication: PHI RB room collapses to 4th-string (Dameon Pierce); pass-catchers still viable with McKee.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RBs or PHI pass game pivots; volume to remaining backs.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Sunday.
items.implication: Huntley or backup starts; Ravens pass game downgraded, Flowers/Andrews impacted.
items.opportunity: Fade BAL pass catchers or stream opposing defense.

items.text: Rashee Rice listed OUT (hamstring) with Tyquan Thornton.
items.implication: KC WR targets redistribute to Worthy/others; Mahomes slightly downgraded.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy or KC TE upside; handcuff WRs.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT (quad) with AD Mitchell.
items.implication: NYJ backfield to backups; major RB volume void.
items.opportunity: NYJ RB handcuffs or opposing run defense fade.

items.text: DeVonta Smith listed IN (removed from report) after prior hamstring concerns; returns with Hurts out.
items.implication: Borderline WR2 with McKee; primary target.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) for elite recent usage and soft run defense.
Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) due to tough matchup and QB issues.
items.why: Seattle pass D + shaky QB situation.

items.text: Ravens officially activated WR Ja’Kobi Lane from IR; expected to play Sunday vs Browns.
items.why: Activated from IR; expected to contribute.
items.implication: Depth WR addition with Lamar out; limited but positive for BAL receiving.
items.opportunity: Deep league dart or BAL target share monitor.
